notes.title: Angel Wings: Endless Night is Available Now!
notes.notes:
The long-anticipated spin-off sequel  to[i] Angel Wings[/i], [i]Angel Wings: Endless Night[/i] is finally available for download! 

[h1]The Endless Night[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714360/Angel_Wings_Endless_Night/

A dark thriller with both comedic and spine-chilling moments, Angel Wings: Endless Night is a love letter to classic survival horror games, brought to life in visual novel form.

As a spin-off sequel to Angel Wings, Endless Night finds you trapped in a haunted mansion with no means of escape. Using your wits and the help of your unlikely companion, will you find a way to end this eternal darkness?

[h1]Supporter Pack[/h1]
Want more Endless Night? Curious about our development? Do you simply want some horrifying art to look at every day? The Endless Night Supporter Pack includes an artbook PDF with over 90 pages of content, including full-page displays of the art of Endless Night, as well as interesting tidbits about the characters, lore, and design process. The Supporter Pack also includes a selection of 4K desktop wallpapers, as well as a look at unreleased design prototypes.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2200070/Angel_Wings_Endless_Night__Supporter_Pack/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32834152/e294e26447bbe6e62ef329e966ff0a6813c44874.png[/img]

[h1]Angel Wings Swag[/h1]
For those looking to take their fandom a step further, we have officially opened an Etsy shop! Containing t-shirt designs and posters from the [i]Angel Wings[/i] series, this is our first dive into physical merchandise. Check it out!

[url=https://www.etsy.com/shop/RumRDesign?ref=dashboard-header]Etsy Shop[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32834152/abfd69c1bf4efe5409fab882797c8ef47c85e37f.jpg[/img]

-RumR Design Team

notes.title: Angel Wings v1.1 (Skip Feature) Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi all,


Thank you all for your continued support of [i]Angel Wings[/i]. This patch brings the long-awaited Skip feature to the game. Special thanks to everyone who helped us by testing the Beta branch!

[h2]How Does Skip Mode Work?[/h2]
Skip Mode can be activated from the menu bar or by pressing the K key on your keyboard. This is a toggle on/off feature that will automatically skip any text you have previously seen starting from today. Anything seen before today will not be in the log file.
The only exception in this case is when a character is met on Day 1 vs. Day 2 - even though these are similar, the game treats them as completely different occurrences.

To disable Skip mode, just press K again.

[h2]Help! My Saves Don't Work![/h2]
As mentioned in a previous update post, Patch 1.1 causes previous saves to be invalidated. This is due to altering the story file, which we cannot do without breaking old saves. However, if you'd like to continue your pre-1.1 playthrough, you can do so on the Legacy Branch.

Navigate to [i]Angel Wings[/i] in your Steam library and right click > Properties:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32834152/aa2a005a1364117cd0e4ffaba1764f04a84faed3.png[/img]

Once the Properties Menu is opened, select the Betas option on the sidebar, and select "legacy" in the dropdown menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32834152/0f2593c70fbbecd364aefc8e0c27ebf94a3005e6.png[/img]

Once Steam is finished updating, you are officially on the Legacy branch! Don't forget to switch back once you're done!


[h1]Patch 1.1 Notes[/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Skip Mode has been added to game.
[*] Cloud Saves are now enabled.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in Love storylines where choosing Hyedong at the hotel gala would act as if the player chose Jei.
[*] Jihyun will no longer appear on the beach if the player has not met her.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would crash if attempting to open the History window when no text was present.
[/list]

[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
[list]
[*] The producers of Hot Take have remembered how to do math. They will also no longer advertise events that have already occurred.
[/list]


Thank you for all your patience and support as we work through these new features. This is only the start of what we have planned for [i]Angel Wings[/i], so please stay tuned for more!

As usual, if there are any questions or concerns please let us know in the comments below.

notes.title: Skip Mode Early Access (Instructions Inside!)
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Due to popular demand, we are opening the Beta branch to all users as of today. This will allow players to test the Skip function a week before live launch. While there may be some hiccups, we hope you can all assist us in identifying any issues.


[h2]What Should I Know About the Beta?[/h2]

Please understand that the Beta branch is considered to be a testing ground, and we [b]cannot guarantee full stability.[/b] If you encounter crashes or saving issues, please notify us immediately.

That said, the Beta branch will grant access to the Skip feature as well a host of other fixes we've implemented. Because of these new features, [b]your previous saves will not work in this branch.[/b]

[h3]How Does Skip Mode Work?[/h3]
Skip Mode can be activated from the menu bar or by pressing the K key on your keyboard. This is a toggle on/off feature that will automatically skip any text you have previously seen (as of today - previous text will not be logged). 
The only exception in this case is if a character is met on Day 1 vs. Day 2 - even though these are similar, the game treats them as completely different occurrences.

To disable Skip mode, just press K again.


[h2]How To Access the Beta Branch[/h2]

Navigate to [i]Angel Wings[/i] in your Steam library and right click > Properties:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32834152/aa2a005a1364117cd0e4ffaba1764f04a84faed3.png[/img]

Once the Properties Menu is opened, select the Betas option on the sidebar, and select "beta" in the dropdown menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32834152/0f2593c70fbbecd364aefc8e0c27ebf94a3005e6.png[/img]

Once Steam is finished updating, you are officially in the Beta mode!

As usual, if there are any questions or concerns please let us know in the comments below!

notes.title: Angel Wings v.1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi all,

The first week of the [i]Angel Wings[/i] launch has been a joy so far, and we've been left speechless by all the support! On a personal level, I've been absolutely touched by all the kind words and comments everyone has left for us.

We've also heard your feedback loud and clear, and while today's patch doesn't hit everything we'd like to yet, we hope it will make your experience a little more fun.

[h1]Patch 1.0.1 Notes[/h1]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Yujeong Good End requirements have been lowered. 
[*] Chaeng Medium End requirements have been lowered. This means players should encounter the Bad End less often.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed the default resolution of the game client to 1280x720. This should alleviate scaling issues on smaller screens such as laptops.
[*] Fixed an issue where the end credits would repeat multiple times.
[*] Fixed a bug where clicking the Resume button would occasionally crash the game.
[*] Fixed a potential crash with certain Intel GPUs. This should solve the issue where players could not start the game.
[*] Fixed a rare visual glitch with certain Outfit cards.
[*] Fixed a bug in Nuri's route where the player was occasionally referred to by the incorrect pronoun.
[/list]

[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed "Drift Queen" from the requirements for the achievement "Vintage".
[*] Increased visibility of the skip dialogue in end credits.
[*] The "-windowed" command in Steam options will now start the game in windowed mode. 
[*] The "-safemode" command in Steam options will now reset your settings to default. 
[/list]


This is only a small portion of the changes we have planned for [i]Angel Wings[/i], but we hope that these changes will improve your gameplay experience. Again, we're thankful to everyone who has taken the time to play the game and we hope you've enjoyed your time in New Elvis City so far!

notes.title: Angel Wings Dev Update V: Extra Features (Final Dev Update, Nov 2020)
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Hope everyone is doing well. The last few weeks have been crazy for our team as we've spent hours testing and tweaking [i]Angel Wings[/i] to a point we're comfortable with. It's our pursuit of perfection that has led to us waiting on a release date until we're 100% sure we can deliver on it. 

That said, this will be our [b]Final Dev Update[/b] - the next time you hear from us will be a release announcement. As of right now, our prior estimate of December/January still holds true, so no worries there!

Today we'll show off some of the awesome new features you can expect from [i]Angel Wings[/i] once it releases. Some might see them as minor extras, but we feel like they'll be really great aspects of the full game!

[h2]Hot, Fresh and Fly[/h2]

In a visual novel where the majority of the time is spent staring at character models, we felt it appropriate to allow you to customize the looks of the characters in our [i]Angel Wings[/i] universe. We've done this by including a wide variety of outfits for each major character, allowing a fresh and iconic look depending on which outfit is selected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32834152/9d4ac54a8302c19cc1e458ced905219bab31ea93.png[/img]

These outfits are unlocked in a variety of ways (i.e. reaching a certain ending, or a character simply liking you enough) - experiment and find your favorite design! 

And if you haven't yet, the only way to unlock Kei's exclusive Drift Queen outfit is to play the [b]Angel Wings Demo[/b], so make sure you do that!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32834152/d0c0a672da634aa11f4266b13cde72806d13bf2c.png[/img]

[h2]En Route[/h2]

The goal of [i]Angel Wings[/i] is to ensure everyone has a fun, rewarding experience while also providing a sense of challenge and replayability. In order to balance this, we've added a Route Selection mode which will allow you to replay your favorite stories in a condensed format - a single character's story with no overlapping plot lines.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32834152/8f5d75aa21c277f3a473d047c33724e3c34956c2.png[/img]

In order to avoid spoiling the full roster, we've decided not to show the entire Route Selection menu. To unlock these routes, you'll simply need to complete that character's route one time in a regular playthrough - regardless of ending, the route will be unlocked and you can try for any of their other endings.

(You might notice the "Coming Soon" button on the right...more on that post-release!)

[h2]Closing Thoughts[/h2]

We've spent a lot of time and energy adding these extras to the game, because we truly believe these features add a ton of life and variety to the story we want to tell. Hopefully you'll feel the same once you try it out for yourself! 

-Rum

notes.title: Angel Wings Dev Update IV: Story Preview and Closed Beta Testing (Oct 2020)
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Since the day [i]Angel Wings[/i] began development, we’ve focused on writing a compelling and engaging story to match the art and technical design we’ve shared in previous Dev Updates. After all, why play a game if there’s no adventure to be had? 

In today’s Dev Update, we’ll be giving a sneak peek into some of what you can expect out of the [i]Angel Wings[/i] gameplay experience.


[h2]Weaving a Story[/h2]

In case you’re reading this Dev Update without having seen our Steam page, we’ll give you a moment to understand the story of [i]Angel Wings[/i] thus far: 

[i]Upon answering a mysterious phone call, you awaken in an unfamiliar place filled with new faces… Through intricate relationships and thoughtful introspection, will you be able to unravel the reason you are here?[/i]

The premise is simple: You’ve woken up in New Elvis City, a sprawling metropolitan utopia with beautiful scenery, beautiful people, and warm weather year round. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32834152/365f2e33792d130c3388fcf2ec0f3859806a168c.png[/img]

The question is, how did you get here? 

With dozens of memorable characters and hundreds of hand-drawn art pieces, we’ve done our best to bring the world to life. Perhaps you’ll stay a while, and explore what New Elvis has to offer?


[h2]Choose Your Destiny[/h2]

When we sat down and started planning the plot for [i]Angel Wings[/i], our goal was simple: Create a unique experience that suits the player, and provides a rewarding gameplay experience for those who are true to themselves. To accomplish this, upon starting a new game, you will be presented with a choice of three cards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32834152/df70566a3d65e98109ffe4a70c2bb7be43d737b0.png[/img]

This isn’t a decision to be taken lightly, as the card you choose will immediately impact the new life you’ll lead in New Elvis City. For example, a Hierophant character may find comfort in sociable chatter, while a Hermit character may stray towards quieter locales. 


[h2]A One-of-a-Kind Adventure[/h2]

No matter which card you choose, you’ll experience the full depth of the[i] Angel Wings [/i]story, with further choices to customize your gameplay experience. Thanks to a complex story system, no two players will experience the game the same way. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32834152/273e1c750b3b14f7c01581a9b06dfbd60f913fac.png[/img]

So sit back, relax, and play the game however you want - with enough luck and patience, you’ll be rewarded with one of our 20+ unique endings. 


[h2]One Last Thing...[/h2]

As you read this Dev Update, we've officially begun our final stretch of beta testing (yes, for real). Our qualified team of dedicated testers is helping us track down any remaining bugs or quirks in our code before our final release. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32834152/7126fa7a5b80d22e0203ef704d3aa6f7a69dc794.png[/img]
[i]Generally my reaction upon finding bugs in the game[/i]

We hope you’ll enjoy the ride with us when [i]Angel Wings[/i] releases this winter!

notes.title: Angel Wings Dev Update III: Technical Details (Oct 2020)
notes.notes:
Hi all, virusek20 from the dev team here.
In this dev update we'll cover the technical side of Angel Wings and various challenges we had to overcome during development.
Just like the previous Dev Update, this one will also answer the question "Why is this taking so long?"

[h2]Picking the right tools for the job[/h2]
If you've ever tried making a visual novel, you’ve probably heard about RenPy or similar tools, right? We decided to use none of those, in favor of our own custom engine written in C++ using SFML. This was done in order to achieve an experience that reflected the original concept instead of trying to work around existing tech. RenPy basic setup takes only a couple of minutes, while designing everything from scratch is a several month-long project.
As development continued, some more complex problems were encountered. We found that SFML may have not been the best tool for the job. We contemplated switching to yet another library later during the development, but it was already too late at that point and we didn’t want to risk delaying the project yet again. After all, one could keep switching tech like this forever, never getting anything done, so we instead decided to stick with what we had.

[h2]Cutting edge tech for a cutting edge VN[/h2]
SFML is fine for its intended purpose, but the more tech-savvy readers may be puzzled as to why we decided to use a library like this if we claim we want to use cutting edge tech. We've slowly replaced pieces of this library bit by bit with modern technology used in high quality games while still retaining the fast development speeds that SFML offers. Honorable mentions are BC7 texture compression, DDS texture format, ZSTD compression for assets and the usage of modern OpenGL rendering techniques alongside the existing SFML pipeline.
We didn't implement all these features just for the sake of it, but as a result of various technical challenges we've come across during development. Did you know that every single CG and background are at least 4K, some of them even more? Some scenes in the game use dozens of these in short timespans, meaning we had to get around problems like slow HDD speeds and massive memory usage that comes with 4K textures. As it turns out, modern AAA titles have already solved all these issues, so we tried to implement the very same tech into our engine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32834152/542f1ca1be65b03773f6b117cea02e190fe77465.png[/img]

[h2]History of the Angel Wings codebase[/h2]
Before I joined, around 2017, there existed a prototype Angel Wings engine written in C# using Monogame that eventually got scrapped in favor of the current C++ based engine. This decision set the development back a few months, but I believe that this decision was worth it in the end. The major reason for such a big change was the fact that one of our lead developers was much more experienced with C++ and didn't want to slow the development down by using a language he wasn't proficient in. I personally never worked on this prototype as I joined after the switch, but as a .NET developer I must admit I would have preferred to refine the old version instead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32834152/1441a7238108fc6a9e7985b835d172c527d9d553.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32834152/dd002d792cf8a77514938a47c6acd263334968b5.png[/img]


[h2]It's about the journey, not the destination[/h2]
While this project has slowly grown into a full-sized game it's always been more of a fun side project for me, so I never opposed choices that involved "reinventing the wheel" in favor of using existing tech. Could we make something similar in an existing engine? Sure, but we wouldn't learn as much as we did during the last few years while working on this game.
Given the fact that neither of us on the dev team are game developers by trade (or at least were at the start of this project), we’ve also gone through several rewrites of certain parts of the game because we realized that we went in a direction that lead to a dead end, so those also accounted for the longer dev time.

[h2]Final thoughts[/h2]
So now you see why the programming part of Angel Wings took as long, if not longer, as the art side covered by the last dev update. Despite maybe sounding a bit bitter about the whole journey, I can safely say I’ve had a lot of fun and that it’s been an invaluable experience for me, both for my professional life as well as making new friends along the way.
As always, please don't hesitate to reach out with questions or comments. We're always happy to provide updates on the game whenever we can.

-virusek20

notes.title: Angel Wings Dev Update II: Art Design (Sep 2020)
notes.notes:
Hi all,

As [i]Angel Wings[/i] marches on towards completion, we figured it would be a good time to let you in on some of the art process and thoughts behind our design decisions. 

In essence, this Dev Update will answer the question "Why is this taking so long?"

[h1]Art Design[/h1]

With only one artist working on the entirety of Angel Wings, it's often a daunting task when considering the vast amount of content that needs to be created for a game of this magnitude. With a final script that's longer than most fantasy novels, there is a need for diverse and varied environments for the player to encounter - we certainly don't want the game feeling stale halfway through!

[h2]Environmental Detail[/h2]

Initially, we envisioned Angel Wings as a light and simple school simulation game, similar to classic titles such as [i]Clannad[/i] or [i]Kanon[/i]. This simple design philosophy was reflected in some of the first environments for the game, illustrated all the way back in 2017.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32834152/312ad7cfc3e32dcab61d7f0124f8260d4d496210.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32834152/77b0de2232950cebf6585f14d090b562336a652d.png[/img]

However, as the development progressed and we gained a stronger understanding of our vision for the story, we realized that the backgrounds and environments are just as important as any of the other visual assets. As a result, some of the art has evolved over the years to meet our new standards of quality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32834152/73a671dc8b19c594fb4f885053ec070476007026.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32834152/fcd0c64872830a7b05e2625a5135fcf95f4caf7a.png[/img]

In the current build of [i]Angel Wings[/i], the game boasts over 140 backgrounds for the player to experience. This includes day/night variants as well as other exciting visuals.

[h2]Character Design[/h2]

In the initial 2017 conception of Angel Wings, the characters maintained a very minimal, anime-styled approach. This initial design choice was made in order to facilitate a quicker turnaround time for the complete art assets. As the story evolved, so did our character designs. Each character has gone through multiple iterations in order to create a high quality model that captures some of their best personality traits.

For example, while Hyedong's pose has remained more or less the same throughout the years, her outfit and posture have been updated to reflect her bouncy and outgoing personality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32834152/cdbe62d45428337eab5376a0855c856dba4b95d5.png[/img]

[h2]Special Scenes[/h2]

For key moments in the story, we wanted to leave a stronger impression on players by making specialized art for those specific moments. These assets take the longest to create, but if you ask us, they're worth the effort!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32834152/9a9b8400806329897734d2034e3ed4d0805e083d.png[/img]

[h1]Final Thoughts[/h1]

The art journey for [i]Angel Wings[/i] has certainly not been an easy one - more than anything, it's been a learning process filled with blood, sweat, and tears (not literally, you won't find any blood or sweat in the graphics for the game). We hope that those who have shown support for our team can continue to do so as we tackle the final stretch of development! 

As always, please don't hesitate to reach out with questions or comments. We're always happy to provide updates on the game whenever we can.

-RumR

notes.title: Angel Wings Dev Update I : Announcements and Logo Changes (Sep 2020)
notes.notes:
Hi all,

With some fans inquiring about the current status of Angel Wings and the future of the project, we believed it was best to address some of the questions and concerns from the community.

First of all, we're truly touched and absolutely thankful for all of your kind and positive encouragement over the years - we've had fans on all sorts of social media platforms express their support for Angel Wings since its inception in late 2017.

With both our artists and programmers going through a host of major life changes as well as some unforeseeable challenges, the development has certainly taken longer than we'd like. That said, we're happy to report that the project is still chugging along! 

A quick (recent-ish) update for us to share now: The new logo and graphical assets on the Store page! This brings a lightweight, modern aesthetic to a logo that was starting to feel dated.

The old logo:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32834152/c95abffc593f354c22faa0c2d6451338f9a0a41f.png[/img]

New:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32834152/e719ad3e7e813e9d44219ca37f73941a19ccf4d2.png[/img]

In the next few days, we'll be sharing some more of the exciting new updates we've made since our latest demo release, and we hope that this will be the beginning of a more regular cadence of dev updates leading to the eventual full release. 


Thank you for all of your support!
-Rum
